prompt: The design team says cropped screenshots without the logo are recognizable as the brand. Turn this heuristic into a defensible validation study for prospective customers.
expected_outcomes: Research question and audience are explicit
Multiple representative stimuli and competitor/category controls are used
Correct association and misattribution are captured
Internal heuristic is distinguished from validated participant evidence
must_not: Treat designer opinion as participant evidence
Assume color recall alone proves brand recognition
